name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis on port 6379 with authentication and required runtime directories, and applies post-install configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application in a virtual environment, provisions its database and user, and runs it with systemd and Uvicorn.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content and development certificates, while applying firewall, fail2ban, SSH, sysctl, and Nginx security settings.
